## ⚠️ Important Considerations

- Pagination logic can vary a lot depending on your specific use case — some teams prefer offset-based, others cursor-based. It really depends on your requirements.
- There are several ways to approach shared pagination helpers. Both inline slicing and centralized helpers have their merits, though centralizing is generally considered best practice for this kind of duplication.
- As of my last knowledge update in September 2021, `Array.prototype.slice` was non-mutating and returns a shallow copy — worth keeping in mind if the arrays ever contain nested objects.
